messages:
elaine: quick q — how should gateway decide between workspace-scoped routing vs. VPC/private-endpoint routing when a request has both headers? e.g. X-Workspace: ws_123 and X-VPC-Endpoint: vpce-abc. we have dedicated pools tied to workspaces and also private endpoints tied to VPCs. do we prefer strict vpc isolation or workspace affinity?

sam: tldr: prefer strict VPC isolation for private endpoints. if the ingress came via a customer private endpoint we should honor that and not route to public/dedicated workspace pools.

yuval: +1 for safety but we need to handle the common case where customers use a shared VPC but want workspace isolation inside it. suggestion: routing policy = match(vpc_endpoint) -> enforce vpc policy; else match(workspace) -> workspace pool. fallback rules for when pool not available.

leo: UX note: console rollout UX needs to show which rule matched (vpc vs workspace) and allow admins to set precedence per private endpoint. otherwise support will get a bunch of "why did my traffic go to shared pool" tickets.

elaine: what about header spoofing? if someone can set X-VPC-Endpoint in the request we must ignore it unless it came from our gateway with TLS client cert or we validated source IP.

sam: exactly. gateway should canonicalize and scrub untrusted headers. only accept X-VPC-Endpoint if it was added by the edge (ingress) component. all other headers treated as hints.

infra-bot: deploy ci/gateway/2026-03-18: added middleware to strip untrusted routing headers unless verified by ingress metadata. :rocket:

yuval: telemetry: emit event `routing.decision` with fields [match_type:(vpc|workspace|fallback), pool_id, route_path, reason] — we can then alert on unexpected fallbacks. also surface token/quota buckets that were consulted.

sam: also add `routing.audit` logs that contain the sanitized headers and the verification status so we can debug spoof attempts. keep PII out.

elaine: sample policy sketch: ```yaml
- name: vpc-first
  match:
    - source: ingress
      has_verified_vpc: true
  action: route_to: vpc_pool
- name: workspace-fallback
  match:
    - workspace_header: present
  action: route_to: workspace_pool
- name: global-fallback
  action: route_to: public_default_pool
```

leo: can we add per-workspace overrides for dedicated pool affinity? some customers expect workspace pinning even inside a VPC when they own the pool. maybe allow a flag `vpc_precedence: optional/strict` on the private endpoint config.

yuval: fine as long as `strict` is default for compliance. optional is a risk, document it clearly and require org-admin consent.

elaine: ok next steps: sam/infra to prototype ingress header verification and scrub, yuval to propose telemetry event shape, leo to design console rule inspector. i'll open a tiny RFC. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
